fields.description:
The Mahindra Thar ROXX 4x4 is a premium suv in the Indian automotive market, starting at an ex-showroom price of ₹ 8.00 Lakh. Powered by a refined 1.5L CRDi Turbocharged Diesel delivering 115 bhp and 250 Nm, the Thar ROXX 4x4 strikes an ideal balance between performance, fuel efficiency (21.8 km/l ARAI), and everyday driving comfort.

Inside the cabin, the Thar ROXX 4x4 offers a spacious 5 Seater layout equipped with modern infotainment, smart connectivity features, and comprehensive safety equipment including 6 Airbags, ABS with EBD, ISOFIX, ESP. Whether commuting through dense urban traffic or embarking on long highway road trips, the Mahindra Thar ROXX 4x4 provides a reliable, stylish, and feature-packed driving experience.

fields.title: Understanding On-Road Price Calculation in India: Ex-Showroom, Road Tax, RTO & TCS
fields.excerpt: Demystifying road tax slabs, Pre-GST calculations in Gujarat/Chandigarh, 1% TCS rules, and hidden RTO costs when buying your new car.
fields.body:
Why Ex-Showroom Price is Not What You Pay

When buying a new car in India, the price advertised by carmakers is the ex-showroom price. However, driving the vehicle legally out of the dealership requires registering it with your state RTO and securing mandatory insurance coverage.

Key On-Road Price Components

  • Ex-Showroom Price: Base factory cost including GST and central excise.
  • Road Tax (State RTO Tax): Computed based on state policies. States like Delhi apply 7–11%, whereas Maharashtra applies up to 13–14%. In states like Gujarat, Chandigarh, and Jharkhand, road tax is levied on the Pre-GST price basis, significantly lowering your tax burden!
  • RTO Registration & Statutory Charges: Includes flat fees for registration (₹600), smart card RC (₹200), high-security registration plates (HSRP), and hypothecation charge (₹1,500) if financed.
  • TCS (Tax Collected at Source): A mandatory central government tax of 1% applied on all vehicles exceeding ₹10,000,000 (₹10 Lakhs) ex-showroom price.
  • Insurance Estimate: Typically ~3.5% of ex-showroom value for 1-year comprehensive + 3-year third-party cover.

Use the Car Guide Media On-Road Price Calculator to get instant, accurate, itemized breakdowns tailored to your state!

fields.title: Tata Nexon EV Real-World Test: Range, Charging Speed & State Subsidies Explained
fields.excerpt: We test the updated Nexon EV across 1,500 km of city traffic and highway driving to see if electric mobility makes economic sense.
fields.body:
The EV Advantage on Road Tax

Electric Vehicles benefit from massive road tax concessions across Indian states. In states like Delhi, Gujarat, and Rajasthan, road tax is 0%, saving EV buyers over ₹1.5 to ₹2.5 Lakhs compared to equivalent petrol SUVs.
